name: inv-10-one-engine-owned-path-module
description: Every repository path class the engine writes or protects (harness state and review directories, the State File name, Run Directory layout names, the completion-report root) is defined once, in engine/src/core/engine-owned-paths.ts (loom#198, Cause 2). Two observers that each kept their own list (#192, #196) were one bug, and a third list had already drifted (remediation excluded .claude/state but not .pi/state). A module that restates one of these literals in code is the next drift; prose in a comment defines nothing and is not matched.
fixHint: Import the constant or the classifier from engine/src/core/engine-owned-paths.ts (HARNESS_STATE_DIRECTORIES, RUN_DIRECTORY_ROOTS, CANONICAL_TASK_GRAPH_PATHS, TASK_GRAPH_FILE_NAME, RUN_LAYOUT_COMPONENTS, COMPLETION_REPORT_ROOT, canonicalWaveGateRunsRoot, engineOwnedPathClass) instead of restating the path. A new engine-owned path class is added there, once.
